gauge.name: San Francisco River below Glenwood

impacts.statement: Stage of Record since 1928.  Hardest hit was the reserve area (about 50 river miles upstream) where the town's sewage treatment plant was badly damaged. One doublewide home was washed away and several homes were damaged.  The Cottonwood Canyon Creek Bridge on US HWY 180 south of the NM SR12 Intersection collapsed.

hydronotes.statement: River forecasts for this location take into account past precipitation and the precipitation amounts expected approximately 10 days into the future from the forecast issuance time.

gauge.forecastReliability: Forecasts are issued as needed during times of high water, but are not routinely available.
